newsitem.title: FINLAND: TAPIOLA SEES GOOD 96 EARNINGS, TURNOVER UP 9 PCT.
newsitem.headline: TAPIOLA SEES GOOD 96 EARNINGS, TURNOVER UP 9 PCT.

text.p: Finnish insurance group Tapiola-yhtiot said in a statement on Thursday it expected to report good earnings for 1996, and that combined turnover of its units would rise by naerly nine percent on 1995.

"According to Tapiola-yhtiot's result forecast 1996 will be a good year," Tapiola said. "Based on available information, the ongoing year looks like becoming a good one for all four Tapiola companies," it added.
"The aggregate turnover of the companies will rise 8.9 percent according to the forecast," Tapiola said.

Vahinko-Tapiola's operating profit would rise to 298 million markka in 1996 from 131 million last year. Its premium income would increase almost three percent to 1.57 billion markka, and net investment income would rise almost 75 percent and exceed 381 million markka. It would book sales profits of 62 million markka.

The combined 1996 profit of Henki-Tapiola and Yritysten Henki-Tapiola would be about 153 million markka, up from 125 million in 1995. Combined premium income would rise more than 25 percent to 914 million markka and net investment income would rise some 12 percent to 358 million markka.
Elake-Tapiola's premium income would rise 8.6 percent to 3.27 billion markka while 1996 pension pay-outs would total 2.65 billion markka, Tapiola said, but gave no comparison for the latter figure.
Elake-Tapiola's profit on investments would be 201 million markka this year, it said, but gave no comparison.
